sources.citation: Awambeng, Elizabeth Ncheafor. 2002. Tonal processes in Nkwen: an autosegmental perspective. Journal of West African Languages 29(1): 103-120.

sources.note: Nothing. Whole article (18 pp., scanned and read) treats H/L tone, floating tones, docking, high spread, simplification, downstep and upstep in the associative construction; the words stress, accent, prominence never occur. Only that Nkwen 'has segmental and tonal alternations at the phonetic level' (p. 103).
